# A component method named as a value is a function the interpreter can call.
# lookup answered a bare method name with "function requires arguments"
# unless it took none, and a LambdaValue bound the arguments to the receiver
# parameter first. testdata/list_map_component_method.txtar is the compiled
# half.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component panel node {
    var base = 10
    var got = ""
    func tag(x int) => "{x + base}"
    button #run(text="run", @click {
        got = [4, 5].map(tag).join(",")
    })
    text(value=got)
}

func testMapByName(t Test, c panel) {
    c.run.click()
    t.assert(c.got == "14,15")
}
